The House Standing Committee on Primary Industries adopted an inquiry into factors shaping social licence and economic development outcomes in critical minerals projects across Australia on 15 December 2025, following a referral from the Minister for Resources, Hon Madeleine King MP.

The Committee is seeking written submissions, providing recommendations in response to the inquiry terms of reference by Tuesday, 31 March 2026. Further information about making a submission to a parliamentary committee is available here.

Please note that contributions to the inquiry are not automatically published on the website. Each contribution is processed by the Secretariat and considered by the Committee to determine whether it will be accepted as a submission and authorised for publication.

If you are experiencing issues uploading your submission through the online portal, please email your submission to pic.reps@aph.gov.au

Committee Secretariat contact:

Committee Secretary
House of Representatives Standing Committee on Primary Industries
PO Box 6021
Parliament House
Canberra ACT 2600

Phone: 02 6277 4500
pic.reps@aph.gov.au
